caseName: Cincinnati, Hamilton & Dayton Railway Co. v. McCollum
caseNameFull: Cincinnati, Hamilton & Dayton Railway Company, in Error v. Joseph M. McCollum, Administrator of the Estate of Joseph William Roebuck
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Indiana.
attorneys: Mr. Morison R. Waite and Mr. HUrvey J. Elam for plaintiff in error., Mr. Merrill Moores for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Louisville & Nashville R. R. Co. v. Melton, 218 U. S. 36, 52, 53; Lindsley v. Natural Carbonic Gas Co., 220 U. S. 61, 78; Mutual Loan Co. v. Martell, 222 U. S. 225, 235; St. Louis, Iron Mountain & Southern Ry. Co. v. Arkansas, 240 U. S. 518.
